job.job_description:
Key Responsibilities

Develop and deploy AI-based applications leveraging LLMs and Generative AI models like GPT, Gemini, or similar frameworks
Build scalable backend systems using Python, ensuring seamless integration with UI/UX components
Design and optimize generative AI models to address diverse business challenges
Fine-tune pre-trained LLMs to align with specific use cases
Work closely with cross-functional teams, including data scientists, UI/UX developers, and product managers, to deliver robust solutions
Collaborate with clients to gather requirements and develop customized AI capabilities
Deploy solutions on cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) and ensure system scalability and performance



Qualifications

Bachelors Degree (preferred CS/IT) in advanced analytics or ML or Master's in Machine Learning, Statistics, Econometrics, or a related field
4-7 years of professional experience in Data Science or AI/ML application development.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI models and frameworks
Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies and best practices in Gen AI & Data Science



Must-Have Skills:

Proficiency in Python for application development
Experience working with Generative AI frameworks and libraries (e.g., Hugging Face, OpenAI API, LangChain)
Strong knowledge of LLMs and fine-tuning techniques
Experience with RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) techniques & Agentic workflow
Hands-on experience with Python web frameworks like Flask, FastAPI, or Django
Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP) for deployment and scaling
job.ai_reason: Strong production RAG experience and transferable cloud skills.
